ἐμβόσκομαι.definition: feed on or in, Ph.2.289: metaph., ib.351

ἔμβρεγμα.definition: lotion, Dsc.2.124, Aret.CA1.1, Archig. ap. Gal.8.150

ἐμβρέχω.definition: treat with embrocations, Philum. ap; wet, J.BJ3.7.13:—Med., soak, Nic.Al.237:—Pass., to be dipped, plunged, Sotionp.183 W.; to be soaked, Dsc.Eup.1.1: aor. 2 part. Pass. Paul.Aeg.3.43

ἐμβρίθεια.definition: weight, dignity, Suid., Zonar; clumsiness of parts, opp. Epicur.Nat.14.4

ἐμβριθής.definition: weighty, of ropes, Hdt.7.36; metaph., weighty, grave, dignified, Pl.Ep.328b; Plu.Per.4; Id.Brut.1; dignity, D.H.Amm.2.2; Hp.Ep.11; Jul.Or.2.88a; the more sedate, opp. Pl.Tht.144b

ἐμβριμάομαι.definition: of persons, to be deeply moved, Ev.Jo.11.33,38; admonish urgently, rebuke, E.Fr.1099: c. dat. pers., LXXDa.11.30, Ev.Matt.9.30, Marc.1.43

ἐμβρίμησις.definition: = foreg., Aq., Sm.Ps.37.4, Thd.Is.30.27, Eustr.in EN119.21, Steph.in Hp.1.76D

ἐμβροντάω.definition: dumbfounder, Eup.17; Pass., to be struck by lightning, distd. fr. X.HG4.7.7

ἐμβροντησία.definition: sheer stupidity, Id.Sam.196; madness, Plu.2.1119b, Philostr.VS2.27.5

ἐμβρόντητος.definition: thunderstruck, stupefied, stupid; later of ideas, crack-brained, mad, Porph.Chr.35; Orph.Fr.47

ἐμβρυοθλάστης.definition: instrument to extract a foetus, Gal.19.104

ἐμβρυοτομέω.definition: cut up the foetus in the womb, c. acc., Olymp.in Grg.p.257 J., Aspasia ap.Aët.16.22:—Pass., of the foetus, to be cut up in the womb, Vett.Val.53.27, Procl.Par.Ptol.214

ἐμβρυοτομία.definition: cutting up of the foetus, Gal.19.107, Philum. ap. Aët.16.23, Olymp.in Grg.p.258 J., PTeb.676, Ptol.Tetr.149, etc

ἐμβρυοτόμος.definition: instrument for cutting up the foetus, Sor.2.63

ἐμβρυουλκία.definition: extraction of the foetus, Id.1.68 , Archig. ap. Aët.16.91, Gal.19.107

ἐμβρωματίζω.definition: = EM819.6, Suid.:—aor. Pass. in med. sense, take a meal or snack, Apollon.Lex. s.v

ἐμετήριος.definition: = I: an emetic, ibid.: pl. Aret.CD1.3

ἐμετοποιΐα.definition: causing to vomit, Dionys.Aeg. ap. Phot.Bibl.p.130B

ἐμμαίνομαι.definition: to be mad at, Act.Ap.26.11, J.AJ17.6.5

ἐμμάσσομαι.definition: press upon, inflict, Nic.Th.767; Opp.H.2.502; Call.Dian.124; APl.4.273 :—late in Act., smear, PMag.Lond.121.230

ἐμμάχομαι.definition: fight a battle in, cf. D.C.50.12

ἐμμεθύσκομαι.definition: Pass., to be drunk in, J.BJ4.4.3

ἐμμείγνυμι.definition: mingle, Plu.2.61b; of persons, encounter, Pi.P.4.251

ἐμμειδιάω.definition: smile in, Philostr.Ep.51; to be glad at, of hounds, X.Cyn.4.3

ἐμμελετάω.definition: exercise or train in a thing, Plu.Cim.18, etc.; to practise upon, Pl.Phdr.228e; give a lecture, Plu.2.932d

ἐμμένω.definition: fut. S.OC648, etc.: pf; abide by, stand by, cleave to, be true to, c. dat., Hdt.9.106; A.Ch.977, etc.; S.OT351; Id.Aj.350; Th.5.18, cf. Isoc.7.81; X.Mem.4.4.16; Pl.Ap.39b; Id.Tht.145c, etc.; remain constant to them, A…

ἐμμεστόομαι.definition: Pass., to be filled quite full, S.Ant.420 , El.713 , unless in both passages be adverbial, v. B.3

ἐμμετεωρίζομαι.definition: Pass., to be carried aloft, Philostr.VA1.5

ἔμμετρος.definition: in measure, proportioned, opp; fitting, suitable, Id.Lg.823d; . . ib.955e. Adv. Id.Cra.395c, M.Ant.1.16: Sup. Pl.R.474d; also Lg.674c, prob. in Aristaenet.1.18

ἐμμολύνω.definition: pollute in or with, in Pass., LXXPr.24.9

ἐμπαιδεύω.definition: lecture amongst, Philostr.VS1.21.3:—Pass., to be brought up in, E.Fr.413

ἐμπαιδοτριβέομαι.definition: to be brought up or educated in, D.C.77.21; J.BJ2.8.12

ἐμπαιδοτροφέομαι.definition: Med., bring up one's children on another person's property, D.44.23

ἐμπαλάσσομαι.definition: Pass., to be entangled in, Hdt.7.85; of fish, Ael.NA15.1: abs., entangled one with another, Th.7.84.—Act. Hsch

ἐμπάλλομαι.definition: poet. shake or quiver in, A.R.3.756

ἐμπανηγυρίζω.definition: hold festal assemblies in, Plu.Comp.Per.Fab.1; make a display in, Id.2.532b

ἐμπαραβάλλομαι.definition: throw oneself into, into punishment, Phalar.Ep.132; to venture to believe in one's heart, ib.130

ἐμπαράθετος.definition: laid in or on, Suid., cf. eund.s.v

ἐμπαραλιμπάνω.definition: pass over, c. acc., Them.in Ph.11.29

ἐμπαρασκευάζω.definition: to prepare, Clin. ap. Stob.3.1.76, cf.Aen.Tact.9.3

ἐμπαράσκευος.definition: prepared, Sm.Ps.26.3; a kind of wind-screen for engines, Ath.Mech.33.1. Adv. Suid. s.v

ἐμπαρίσταμαι.definition: Pass. with aor. 2 Act., stand by, Hld.7.19

ἐμπαροινέω.definition: aor. J.Ap.1.8:—behave like one drunken, Luc.Tim.14; act offensively, to another, Ph.2.403, Luc.DDeor.5.4; J.AJ6.12.7; indulge recklessly in slanders, ib.20.8.3

ἐμπαρρησιάζομαι.definition: speak freely against; drawing courage from their purpose to speak openly of the plot, J.AJ15.8.4

ἐμπατέω.definition: walk in or into, c. acc., A.Ag.1434; c. acc., trample on, J.BJ6.9.4: metaph., Agath.4.15:—Med. or Pass., tread the wine-press, Poll.7.151

ἐμπεδορκέω.definition: abide by one's oath, Hdt.4.201, X.Lac.15.7; IG22.111.79:—with a play on Ar.Fr.772

ἐμπεδοσθενής.definition: with force unshaken, a settled, unruffled life, Pi.N.7.98

ἐμπεδόω.definition: impf. X.Cyr.8.8.2: aor. D.C.60.28: :—confirm, ratify, S.Ichn.50; E.IT790, cf. Ar.Lys.211,233, Polem.Hist.83; X.HG3.4.6; . . Pl.Phdr.241b; X.Cyr.5.1.22; Plb.29.24.4; D.H.4.79; Gal.5.315; uphold, Plu.Sol.25:—Med., Ph.1.…

ἐμπειρία.definition: c. gen. rei, experience in, acquaintance with, Antipho5.1; Th.3.95; Pl.R.582b; also X.HG7.1.4; Th.2.3; Plb.10.24.4, etc

ἐμπειροπόλεμος.definition: experienced in war, D.H.6.14, Ph.1.426: Sup., App.BC3.97. Adv. ib.2.36

ἐμπειροπράγμων.definition: gen. versed in affairs, Suid. s.v

ἐμπείρω.definition: fix on or in, Ath.11.488d; impale, J.AJ16.10.3; studded, Alciphr.3.55

ἐμπελαγίζω.definition: to be in or on the sea, IPE12.35 , Ach. Tat.5.9

ἐμπελάζω.definition: bring near, having; intr. in Act., approach, c. dat., h.Merc.523; Democr.166; . .; S.Tr.748; Arist.Mu.395a19: abs., ib.b28, Porph.Abst.2.22; Orph.Fr.32a

ἐμπερίβολος.definition: ornate, expanded, Aristid.Rh.2 p.533 S.; Hermog.Id.1.11; Men.Rh.p.400S

ἐμπεριγράφω.definition: comprehend in a thing, v.l. for S.E.P.1.206 ; describe around, Poll.9.108

ἐμπεριέρχομαι.definition: pass round, prob. in Gal.2.826: metaph., Ph.2.61

ἐμπεριλαμβάνω.definition: encompass, enclose, Hp.Ep.23, Thphr.CP5.3.4; Plu.Ant.63; Sammelb.5233.7 ; J.BJ3.7.7; comprehend, Arist.PA644a12; Inscr.Prien.105.27 :—Pass., Arist.Mete.388b21; is involved in the charge, Id.Rh.1416a20; Epicur.Ep.1p.22…

ἐμπερινοέω.definition: include in the thought of, Epicur.Nat.11.9

ἐμπερίοδος.definition: in periods, periodic, of style, D.H.Comp.9. Adv. Corn.ND27

ἐμπεριπατέω.definition: walk about in, Luc.Ind.6; walk about upon, LXXJb.1.7, al.; trample on, PHolm.18.30: metaph., insult, Plu.2.57a

ἐμπεριρρήγνυμι.definition: break all round, v.l. in Arist.HA557b26

ἐμπερισπούδαστος.definition: zealously frequented, of temples, interpol. in J.Ap.2.35

ἐμπερίσχεσις.definition: Astrol., hemming in of a planet by two others, Vett.Val.5.15, Porph.in Ptol.188, Cat.Cod.Astr.8.114.23, Heph.Astr.1.15

ἐμπετάννυμι.definition: in Pass., to be hung about with cloths, Socr.Rhod.1

ἐμπιέζω.definition: press, squeeze, in Pass., Hp.Gland.13, Plu.2.1005a

ἐμπίεσμα.definition: depressed cranial fracture, Id.Fract.6, Heliod. ap. Orib.46.14.1, Paul.Aeg.6.90

ἐμπικραίνομαι.definition: Med. or Pass., to be bitter against, Hdt.5.62, D.C.47.8: abs., Eus.Mynd.54; of disease, become virulent, J.AJ17.6.5

ἐμπιλέομαι.definition: Pass., to be compressed, Pl.Ti.74e, D.S.2.52

ἐμπίμπλημι.definition: Ion.2sg.pres. Hp.Morb.2.14, part; fill a hungry man with food, Od.17.503

ἐμπιπίσκω.definition: aor. Pi.Fr.111.1:—Pass., aor. 1 causal of give to drink, Pi.l.c., Nic.Al.519:—Med., fill oneself, Id.Th.573, Al.320:—Pass., of liquor, to be drunk, Id.Th.624

ἐμπιστεύω.definition: entrust, D.S.1.67, Plu.Phoc.32; trust in, give credence to, LXXDe.1.32, al., Nic.Dam.Fr.130.19 J.; LXX2 Ch.20.20; ib.3 Ma.2.7

ἐμπίτνω.definition: poet. for fall upon, B.9.24; A.Ag.1468 , Supp.120 , cf. S.Aj.58

ἐμπιτυάζομαι.definition: to be curdled, of milk, Paul.Aeg.5.57

ἐμπλανάομαι.definition: wander in, Hld.2.29: abs., Plu.2.495e: metaph., erratic, ib.336f

ἔμπλαστρος.definition: salve or plaster, Dsc.1.32; said to be later form of Gal.13.372; also Hierocl.Facet.221, PSI3.297

ἐμπλατύνω.definition: widen or extend, LXXEx.23.18: metaph., ib.Pr.18.16:—Pass., to expatiate, Str.8.7.3

ἐμπλέκω.definition: Ep. pf. Hp.Oss.17; metaph., weave by subtle art, A.Pr.610; E.IA936

ἐμπλεονάζω.definition: to be profuse in, Heraclit.Ep.7.6; Sor.1.77

ἐμπλευρόομαι.definition: dash against one's ribs, charge him, S.Fr.53

ἐμπλέω.definition: sail in, Hdt.7.184: abs; in Ion. form float in or upon, Nic.Al.426, Opp.H.1.260 , Aret.SD1.9, 2.1: part. loose, Heliod. ap. Orib.45.6.8

ἐμπληθύνομαι.definition: to be filled with, LXX3 Ma.5.42

ἐμπλήρωμα.definition: space filled up, dub. l. in Gal.18.376

ἐμπλόκιον.definition: a fashion of plaiting women's hair; hair-clasp, BGU1300.24 , LXXEx.35.22, Nu.31.50

ἐμπνευματοποιέομαι.definition: suffer from flatulence; become gaseous, ib.76

ἐμπνευματόω.definition: inflate, in Pass., Thphr.Ign.17; cause flatulence, Diph.Siph.ap.Ath.2.54d, Dsc.2.173:—Pass., suffer from flatulence, Gal.16.833

ἐμπνευμάτωσις.definition: blowing up, inflation; Medic., flatulence, Dsc.2.58 , Gal.UP4.9

ἔμπνοια.definition: inbreathing, inhalation, Luc.Hes.9; breath of life, Sammelb.4127.16

ἐμποδίζω.definition: Att.fut. Id.Ly.210b, later; generally, hinder, thwart, Ar.Av.965, cf. Lys.359, X.Cyr.2.3.10; Aeschin.3.223; to hinder from . . , Pl.Cra.419c; in a thing, Isoc.Ep.4.11, Arist.Pol.1341a6, al., Ph.1.466:— Pass., . . S.Ph…

ἐμπόδιος.definition: at one's feet, Pl.Tht.201a; coming in; commonly, in the way, presenting an obstacle, impeding, c. dat. pers. et rei, Hdt.1.153, cf. 2.158, 5.90; E.Ion862 ; Ar.Lys.531, etc.; Arist.EN1175b2; Id.Mu.399b12

ἐμποδοστατέω.definition: to be in the way, Epicur.Ep.1p.9U., PTeb.24.54 , Ph.1.186:—also v.l. LXXJd.11.35

ἐμποδοστάτης.definition: in the way, ib.1 Ch.2.7, Suid

ἐμπολαῖος.definition: of or concerned in traffic, epith. of Hermes as god of commerce, etc., Ar.Ach.816, Pl.1155, Corn.ND16

ἐμπολεμέω.definition: wage war in, And.3.27, cf. Plu.2.252a

ἐμπόλιον.definition: casing for a dowel, IG2.1054f4,1054g A6

ἐμπολιορκέω.definition: besiege in a place, in Pass., Str.6.2.6; Id.16.2.9:—Act., LXXSi.50.4

ἐμπολιτεύω.definition: to be a citizen, hold civil rights in a; metaph., J.AJ17.10.6; Philostr.VA5.36: —Med., Jul.Or.4.157b

ἐμπομπεύω.definition: walk in procession: hence metaph., c. dat., plume oneself upon, Plu.2.527f; Luc.Ind.10, cf. Arg.2 D.20; D.C.77.5; Procop.Gaz.Ep.69; Id.p.141 B.; Hld.3.7

ἐμπονέω.definition: work on, Alciphr.3.25, cf. JHS33.338; c. acc., elaborate, Gal.4.760

ἐμπορεύομαι.definition: abs., walk, Epich.53, Metag.10; travel for traffic or business, Pl.Lg.952e; Chion Ep.7,8, cf. SIG1166 : metaph., inveigh against the art of healing, Hp.de Arte1

ἐμπορίζομαι.definition: Pass., to be provided, Men.714; acquire, Procop.Aed.1Praef

ἔμπορος.definition: one who goes on ship-board as a; merchant, trader, Semon.16, Hdt.2.39, Th.6.31, etc.; distd. from the retail-dealer by his making voyages and importing goods himself, Pl.Prt.313d, R.371a, Arist.Pol.1291a16, Sch.Ar.Pl.…

ἐμπορπάω.definition: fasten with a brooch or pin:—Pass., they wore garments fastened with a brooch upon the shoulder, Hdt.7.77; Lycurg.40, cf. D.H.2.70, Plu.Mar.17: metaph., LXX3 Ma.7.5

ἐμπόρπημα.definition: garment secured by a brooch, Hsch

ἐμπρησμός.definition: = foreg., SIG679.85 , Plu.2.824e, Gal.9.824, BGU163.6 ; opp. prob. in Ph.2.515

ἐμπρομελετάω.definition: train oneself in beforehand, Ph.2.90, cf. 1.521

ἐμπροσθόκεντρος.definition: with a sting in front, of dipterous insects, Arist.HA490a18

ἐμπροσθότονος.definition: drawn forwards and stiffened, opp. Aret.SA1.6

ἐμπτίσσω.definition: pound in, in Pass., Aq., Thd.Pr.27.22

ἐμπτύω.definition: spit into, Hdt.1.138; spit upon, Ath.8.345c; PMagd.24.7 , Plu.2.189a; Herod.5.76, LXXNu.12.14, Ev.Matt.26.67; Ev.Matt.27.30: c. dat., Arist.Fr.347, Ev.Marc.10.24, etc.:—Med., LXXDe.25.9:—Pass., to be spat upon, Muson.…

ἐμπύρευμα.definition: a live coal covered with ashes, so as to allow of the fire being rekindled , Arist.Frr.225,226, Gal.11.629: metaph., Ph.2.59, al., Longus1.29; Jul.ad Ath.269d: pl., embers, hidden sparks, Simp.in Cael.677.11

ἐμπυρία.definition: divination by fire, in Boeotia, Hsch.; also, = i. e. ordeal by fire, Id

ἐμπυρίζω.definition: = LXXJo.8.28, D.S.2.36, 12.43:—Pass., Chron.Lind.D.41, PTeb.5.135 , Diog.Oen.8, Alex.Trall.Febr.2; Simp.in Epict.p.126D

ἐμπυρισμός.definition: = , Hyp.Lyc.Fr.4, Plb.9.41.5, LXXLe.19.6, Mon.Anc.Gr.19.8, Ath.Mech.12.6; burning of weeds, PSI4.338.7, al

ἐμπυριστής.definition: one who sets on fire, Eust.1023.26

ἐμπυροσκόπος.definition: one who divines by Sch.Il.24.221, Eust.1346.39

ἐμπυρόω.definition: = Inscr.Prien.17.13 , v.l. in Dsc.5.114 , cj. in Hsch. s.v

ἐμφαίνω.definition: exhibit, display in; exhibit, display, Arist.Mu.395b6; Plu.Alex.4; Thphr.CP6.5.2, cf. 6.3.4 ; Plb.3.31.8; Phld.Lib.p.80.; presents no such appearance, Luc.DDeor.26.1; Demetr.Eloc.171

ἐμφανίζω.definition: Att. fut. E.Fr.797: pf; make clear or plain, Pl.Sph.244a, Men.Sam.140, etc.; X.Mem.4.3.4: with a relat., Pl.Ti.61c; . . X.Cyr.8.1.26

ἐμφανισμός.definition: manifestation, Pl.Def.413e; information, disclosure, PAmh.2.30.2, al. , LXX2 Ma.3.9, BCH 48.369 ; indication, A.D.Synt.50.27, al.; explanation, Ptol.Tetr.22

ἐμφαντάζομαι.definition: Pass., to be associated in idea with; to be imagined, Dam.Pr.7

ἐμφαρύγγομαι.definition: aor. 1 part. gulp down, Com.Adesp.996, Dsc.Ther.19

ἐμφέρεια.definition: likeness, Ps.-Dsc.1.1, Ph.1.15, Corn.ND9, Plu.Num.13; Ph.1.433, al., Plu.TG2: pl., Theol.Ar.58

ἐμφερής.definition: answering to, resembling, Sapph.85, freq. in Hdt., as 2.76, al.: Sup., 3.37, al.; also in Trag. and Ar., as A.Ch.206, Supp.279 , S.Aj.1152, Ar.Nu.502; Id.V.1103 ; also in Prose, X.Cyr.5.5.31, Arist.HA26a6, Thphr.HP7.6…

ἐμφέρω.definition: bear or bring in :—Pass., to be; enter in an account, PEleph.15.4 :—Pass., an account was given, Gloss.ad Plb.14.12

ἐμφιλοκαλέω.definition: pursue honourable studies in . ., Plu.2.122e; to be engaged in such a pursuit, Id.Phil.4

ἐμφιλοσοφέω.definition: study philosophy in, Philostr.VA5.18, cf. 1.7: abs., Porph.Abst.4.6, Lib.Or.18.187

ἐμφιλοχωρέω.definition: to be fond of dwelling in, haunt, Luc.Hist.Conscr.1; Alciphr.3.15; J.AJ2.7.2; Agath.5.7: abs., Archemach.1; of things, Gal.16.556

ἐμφλεβοτομέω.definition: split up veins into branches, Hp.Oss.18

ἔμφοβος.definition: Pass., in fear, timorous, Thphr.Char.25.1; terrified, frightened, LXXSi.19.24, Ev.Luc.24.5, al., Bull.Soc.Alex.6.45. Adv. Hsch. s.v

ἐμφορβιόομαι.definition: Pass., to have the mouth-band on , Ar.Av.861

ἐμφόρησις.definition: greedy eating and drinking, Ath.1.10b; Plu.2.472b; Porph.Abst.1.34; repletion, Paul.Aeg.6.96

ἐμφορτίζομαι.definition: Med., = sq., metaph; Pass., to be laden, Timae.Astr.inCat.Cod.Astr.1.98

ἐμφορτόομαι.definition: Med., load with a cargo, freight, Aesop.370b

ἔμφραξις.definition: stoppage, Arist.Pr.870b19; ib.901a1, cf. Str.16.1.10, Porph.Antr.19 ; as a morbid condition, Diocl.Fr.40; impaction, Aret.CA2.9

ἐμφράσσω.definition: bar the passage of, stop, Aeschin.3.223; Epicur.Sent. Vat.47 ; D.S.14.56; Ph.1.246; Plu.2.606d

ἐμφρουρέω.definition: keep guard in a place, Th.4.110, 8.60: c. acc. loci, D.C.47.30, 50.12:—Pass., to be imprisoned, Phalar.Ep.122.4

ἐμφύρω.definition: and mix up, confuse, A.Fr.38, cf. Lyc.1380; Ep. aor. 1 Opp.H.3.498: aor. Med. v.l. in LXXEz.22.6: also fr. pf. part. Pass. Archig. ap. Orib.8.2.18

ἐμφυσάω.definition: blow in, Aret.CA1.2, cf; breathe upon, LXXJb.4.21, Ez.37.9, cf. Ev.Jo.20.22

ἐμφυσιόω.definition: inspire, infuse life into; implant, instil into, X.Lac.3.4; Michel 855.9 :— Pass., Hp.Lex2; Charond. ap. Stob.4.2.24; Diog.Ep.28.1

ἐμφυτεία.definition: grafting, in pl., Arist.Juv.468b23, Thphr.HP1.6.1, 2.1.4, al

ἐμφύτευμα.definition: in Roman law, hereditary lease- hold held on cultivating tenure, Just.Nov.7.3.2; quitrent paid on such property, Cod.Just.1.4.32, PMasp.298.40

ἐμφύτευσις.definition: tenure of such a holding, Just.Nov.7 Pr. 1, al.; PMasp.257.5

ἐμφυτευτής.definition: holder of such an estate, PKlein.Form.314 , Just.Nov.7 Pr. 1

ἐμφυτεύω.definition: implant, engraft, Pl.Ti.70c, IG12.62.34; metaph., Plb.2.41.10, cf.9.29.6; Ph.1.335

ἐμφωλεύω.definition: lurk in . ., Ph.1.315, al., Plu.2.314e; dwell in caves or lairs, OGI424.5

ἐμφωνέομαι.definition: Pass., to be expressed in certain terms, PMasp.6ii 118

ἐμψηφίζω.definition: enter a debt in one's books, Hsch.; cf

ἐμψυχία.definition: having life in one, animation, Epicur.Fr.310, Plu.2.1053b, S.E.P.2.25, Theo Sm.p.187 H., Dam.Pr.18, Simp.in Ph.638.2

ἔμψυχος.definition: having life in one, animate, opp; of diction, animated, vivid, Arist.Fr.129 Bonitz, cf. Luc.Dem.Enc.14; so AP12.56 ; Longin.34.4: Comp., Them.Or.28.342d. Adv. Plu.2.79of: Sup. Herm.in Phdr.p.61A

ἐμψύχω.definition: cool, refresh, Philonid. ap. Ath.15.676c, Antyll. ap. Orib.6.4.1, Aret.CA2.3, Gal.11.387: aor. 2 part. Pass. S.E.P.1.51

ἐναβρύνομαι.definition: fut. App.BC4.68:—pride; to be effeminate in dress, Luc.Salt.2, D.C.43.43

ἐναγελάζομαι.definition: Pass., assemble like a flock in, Epict.Gnom.41

ἐναγκωνίζω.definition: Att. fut. lean on the elbow, Hsch

ἐναλίσκομαι.definition: to be convicted in, Lib.Decl.16.28; Hsch

ἐναλλαγή.definition: interchange, alternando; Gramm., interchange, S.E.M.9.278; A.D.Pron.54.13; D.H.Th.24; POxy.1413.22 ; Hermog.Stat.11: abs., enallage, A.D.Synt.157.12

ἐνάλλαγμα.definition: change: in pl., perverse aclions, Aq. Is.66.4

ἐναλλάσσω.definition: Att. pf. Plb.6.43.2; cross, Philostr.Im.2.7; also intr., cross one another, of veins and arteries, Arist.PA668b21

ἐνάλλομαι.definition: fut. Plu.2.1087b: aor. 1; abs., jump about, dance, Id.V.1305

ἐνάμιλλος.definition: engaged in equal contest with, a match for, Pl.Prt.316b, cf.Isoc.5.68; Pl.R.433d, Criti.110e, cf.Arist.Pol.1283a5; IG22.835.12, cf. Plu.Comp.Ag.Gracch.3; on a par with, D.25.54; Jul.Or.6.182c. Adv. equally with, Isoc.…

ἐναμπέχομαι.definition: Pass., to be clad in, Ph.1.635

ἐναναστρέφομαι.definition: Pass., to be conversant with, Aristox. ap. Stob.3.1.49, Hsch. s.v

ἐνανειλέω.definition: roll back, in Pass., dub. in Gal.6.177

ἐναντιογνώμων.definition: gen. of contrary opinion, ib.29: gloss on Sch.S.OC86

ἐναντιοδύναμος.definition: of opposite function (as; gloss on Eust.108.3

ἐναντίωσις.definition: disagreement, discrepancy, Isoc.12.203 , Pl.R.607c, etc.: pl., contrarieties, Arist.Metaph.986b1, al

ἐναντλέω.definition: draw in: metaph. in Pass., Ph.1.574

ἐναξονίζω.definition: fit with an axle, in Pass., Placit.3.13.3

ἐναπασχολέω.definition: to be wholly occupied in, Steph.in Hp.1.134D

ἐναπειλέω.definition: threaten, prob. f. l. for D.H.5.54

ἐναπεργάζομαι.definition: produce in, Pl.Plt.273c, Sph.236a, v.l. in Isoc.7.38, etc

ἐναποδείκνυμαι.definition: Med., exhibit, to show; approved themselves, gained distinction among others, Hdt.9.58

ἐναποζέννυμι.definition: boil in a thing, Gal.13.118: aor. 1 part. Dsc.4.176

ἐναπόκειμαι.definition: Pass., to be stored up in, Plu.Aem.14, CPHerm.6.14 : metaph., Ph.1.293, Porph.Plot.1, cf. Plot.3.6.2

ἐναποκινδυνεύω.definition: run a hazard in or with, D.C.49.2, cf. J.AJ2.9.4

ἐναποκλύζω.definition: in Pass., to be stirred about in, Dsc.3.34

ἐναπολαμβάνω.definition: cut off and enclose, intercept; Astrol., annul by adverse influence, Vett.Val.112.14

ἐναπολείπω.definition: leave behind in or on, Xenocr.58; Plu.2.91b:—Pass., Arist.Mete.352b35, Ph.1.8

ἐναπόλειψις.definition: leaving of empty spaces within, Thphr.Sens.62

ἐναπολούομαι.definition: wash oneself or bathe in, Ath.2.43a

ἐναπομόργνυμι.definition: wipe off upon, impart, e.g. colour to one, Iamb. ap.Stob.3.3.26:—Pass., Porph.Sent.29

ἐναποπνέω.definition: expire in, D.S.13.89, cf. M.Ant.5.4; expire in the act of . ., Plu.Cor.33; Luc.Harm.2

ἐναποπνίγω.definition: suffocate, drown in, aor. 2 Pass. Terpsicl. ap. Ath.7.325d, cf. Jul.Ep.82; Luc.Peregr.24

ἐναπορέω.definition: dub. l. for to be in doubt, Plb.29.27.6; . . Id.12.25c.1

ἐναποσβέννυμι.definition: aor. quench in a thing, Hp.Mul.1.78; Arist.Pr.937b13; Gal.14.377; Gp.7.12.8:—Pass., Arist.Mete.369b16, Cass.Pr.31, Hld.1.15

ἐναποσημαίνω.definition: indicate or point out in, Plu.Cim.2:—Med., impress or stamp on a thing, Philostr.Im.2.17, cf. Ph.1.291

ἐναποσκήπτω.definition: cause to descend; intr., supervene, attack, Cass.Pr.30, cf. Phlp.inde An.339.5

ἐναποστηρίζομαι.definition: Med., fix oneself in or on, Hp.Acut.9, cf. Placit.2.20.10

ἐναποσφάττομαι.definition: Pass., to be slain among, J.BJ4.6.3

ἐναποτελέω.definition: in Pass., to be produced, Alex.Aphr.Pr.1.134

ἐναποτέμνω.definition: in Pass., to be cut off in, Str.2.5.27

ἐναποτίθεμαι.definition: lay aside or store up in, Id.Nat.Fac.3.12; D.C.73.10; Ph.2.42; deposit, Gal.Nat. Fac.3.7; Jul.Or.1.15d; include, Procop.Gaz.p.169B.; but vent one's anger upon . ., D.S.26.16; produce in, Alex.Trall.10:—Pass., Phld.Her…

ἐναποτυπόομαι.definition: Pass., receive impressions; express, Hierocl.in CA26p.480M

ἐναποφέρω.definition: in Med., receive by heredity, Lib.Decl.43.56

ἐναργυρίζω.definition: to be of silvery appearance, Heph.Astr.1.24

ἐναρίθμιος.definition: in the number, making up; taken into account, valued, Il.2.202; Hsch

ἐναρκέω.definition: suffice, be able, c.inf., Sch.Pi.N.6.97: Hsch

ἐνδαίνυμαι.definition: Med., feast on, f.l. in Ath.7.277a

ἐνδείκτης.definition: informer, complainant, UPZ69.4 , LXX2 Ma.4.1, Philostr.VS2.29

ἑνδεκαγράμματος.definition: of eleven letters, prob. in Ath.10.455b

ἑνδεκάκλινος.definition: with eleven couches: big enough to hold eleven couches, Telecl.44

ἑνδεκάπους.definition: gen. eleven feet long or broad, Milet.7.58 , cf. Poll.1.72

ἐνδελέχεια.definition: continuity, persistency, Choeril.10; Men.744. --Freq. confused with

ἐνδέρω.definition: wrap in skin, of sacrificial offerings, in Pass., SIG1025.48 , 1026.8 , cf. Hsch. s.v

ἐνδεσμεύω.definition: bind to or in, D.S.20.71:—Pass., Dsc.Eup.1.146; D.S.3.40

ἐνδεσμέω.definition: = foreg., Aq.Ex.23.22, al., v.l. in; tie up in, Gp.8.1.3

ἔνδεσμος.definition: bundle, bag, Dsc.3.83, LXX3 Ki.6.10, al; Archit., bonding, SIG2587.308 ; Procop.Pers.2.26

ἐνδημία.definition: Dor. dwelling in a place, lodging, sojourning, IG12.533.5 , cf. 4.679.18 , 5.7 , Hsch

ἐνδιάζω.definition: pass the noon, take a siesta; weave in, in Pass., Hsch

ἐνδιαιτάομαι.definition: Ion. live or dwell in a place, Hdt.8.41; Th.2.43; X.Mem.3.8.8, cf. Crates Theb.15; Plu.2.608e; Lib.Or.64.116

ἐνδιαίτημα.definition: dwelling-place, D.H.1.37, Ph.1.52, al., Plu.2.968b, Phalar.Ep.34 , Agath.3.23; Porph.Marc.11

ἐνδιαίτησις.definition: dwelling in a place, Ph.1.334 , 2.234, Them.Or.27.334a

ἐνδιάκειμαι.definition: Pass., to be set in; Adv. = Hermog.Id.2.7

ἐνδιαλαμβάνω.definition: in pf. part. Pass. divided at intervals, Dsc.2.94

ἐνδιαλλάσσω.definition: Att. alter, Arist.Phgn.806a13:—Pass. sodomite, LXX3 Ki.22.47, Aq.Ge.38.21

ἐνδιαμένω.definition: remain in , dub. l. in D.H.8.62

ἐνδιασκευάζω.definition: work up, in literary composition, Sch.Ar.Ra.1488 , Sch.Il.3.393

ἐνδιασπείρω.definition: sprinkle, Gp.6.8.1:—Pass., to be; impregnated with, Epicur.Fr.250

ἐνδιατίθεμαι.definition: Med., dispose: hence, set forth in

ἐνδιατρίβω.definition: pf. Arist.Mete.357a4:—spend; abs. , spend time in a place, D.33.5; Plb.3.88.1, etc.; D.S.5.44; among them, Luc.Alex.33

ἐνδιάτριπτος.definition: spent, consumed in a process, EM342.34, cf. Et.Gud. s.v

ἐνδιαφθείρω.definition: fut. to destroy in, dub. in Plu.2.658c; destroy a child in the womb, Hp.Carn.19

ἐνδιδύσκω.definition: put on, LXX2 Ki.1.24; clothe, Gp.16.21.9

ἐνδιημερεύω.definition: pass the day in, cj. in Thphr.Char.8.14

ἐνδικάζομαι.definition: to be a litigant, sue, IG5.6.34

ἔνδικος.definition: of things, according to right, just, legitimate, Pi.P.5.103; A.Ch.330 ; Id.Eu.135; IG12.675.4 ; Ep.Rom.3.8: = S.OT682 ; Id.OC925; not speaking truth, Id.OT1158

ἐνδιπλόω.definition: fold in two, Gal.UP14.6,7.12 , Sor.1.14; fold in at the edge, Paul.Aeg.6.65:—hence and folding, Gal.11.508

ἐνδογενής.definition: born in the house, = SIG2854.5, al., LXXLe.18.9

ἐνδοιάζω.definition: aor. Hermog.Id.2.6, App.Mith.33, Luc.Gall.11: :—to be in doubt, at a loss, c. inf., . . Th.1.36: abs., the waverers, Id.6.91; Luc.Herm.25; Plu.Sull.9; Id.Cat. Mi.17; Luc.Phal.2.2; . . D.H.4.58:—Pass., of things, to be…

ἐνδομυχέω.definition: lurk in the recesses of a house, Sch.Ar.V.964; lie hidden, Gp.2.3.9; to be latent, of Steph.in Hp.1.164D

ἐνδοξάζομαι.definition: Pass., to be glorified, LXXEx.14.4, al., 2 Ep.Thess.1.10, PMag.Leid.W.4.17

ἐνδωσείω.definition: to be inclined to yield, D.C.46.37 , Agath.1.9

ἔνεδρον.definition: = I, LXXJo.8.2, 12, al; hindrance, obstruction, POxy.892.11

ἐνειδοφορέω.definition: of a sculptor, work into shape, AP12.57

ἐνείργω.definition: aor. shut up in, Sch.Pi.P.10.72; Phalar.Ep.136.1:—Pass., Tz.H.6.250

ἐνειρωνεύομαι.definition: employ irony in a matter, Procl.in Prm.p.728 S

ἐνεκπλύνω.definition: wash off in a thing, Polyzel.4

ἐνελαύνω.definition: drive in or into, c. dat., Il.20.259, cf. Pi.N.10.70: metaph., Id.P.8.9:—Med., drive in or on, D.C.49.30

ἐνέλκω.definition: in Pass., to be charged, imposed upon an estate, PFlor.370.14 , cf. PLond.5.1695.12 , etc.; of land, to be assigned for forced cultivation, PFlor.50.75

ἐνενηκονταετής.definition: ninety years old, ib.2 Ma.6.24, Ph.1.606 :—contr. Luc.DMort.27.7, App.Pun.106, D.C.69.17

ἐνενηκονταμοιρία.definition: arc of ninety degrees, Pancharius ap. Heph.Astr.2.11

ἐνενηκονταπλάσιος.definition: ninety times as large, c. gen., Gem.6.38

ἐνεξουσιάζω.definition: show independence in; exert authority, be supreme in, Procl.Theol. Plat.6.15, cf. ib.2, Id.inCra.p.98P.; Iamb.Myst.2.3: abs., ib.3.18

ἐνεορτάζω.definition: keep holiday in, Str.12.3.36, cf. Plu.Comp.Per.Fab.1, OGI383.98

ἐνεπιδείκνυμαι.definition: Med., display in; abs., show off, make a display, Ph.2.28, Lib.Decl.16.28

ἐνεπιδημέω.definition: sojourn in, Ael.VH12.52, Ath.6.233a; opp. Id.8.361f, D.C.51.17

ἐνεπισκήπτομαι.definition: Med., claim property alleged to belong; generally, take proceedings to enforce a claim, PGurob 2.28

ἐνεργάζομαι.definition: make or produce in; work for hire in, of harlots, Hdt.1.93; trade with the property, D.44.23; Plb.10.8.7

ἐνεργέω.definition: to be in action or activity, operate; to be efficacious, of drugs, Diocl.Fr.147, Dsc.1.98, al.; ib.106; Plot.6.1.22; to be effective, of troops, Ael.Tact.14.6:—Pass., to be the object of action, Arist.de An.427a7, Ph.…

ἐνεργής.definition: later form of active, effective, D.S.17.44, etc.; of medicines, strong, POxy.1088.56 , Dsc.5.88, etc.: Comp. more effective, Arist.Top.105a19: Sup. D.S.1.88, cf. Dsc.1.19, A.D.Synt.291.9

ἐνεργητέος.definition: to be done, dub. l. in Zeno Stoic.1.49

ἐνερεύγομαι.definition: belch on, Nic.Th.185: also aor.2 Act., . . . . Ar.V.913

ἐνερευθής.definition: somewhat red, Str.3.1.5; Dsc.1.100: Comp., Sor.1.13; of the countenance, flushed, Phld.Ir.p.5 W., Cic. Att.12.4.1; blushing, Plb.31.23.8; Luc.Im.7, cf. Antyll. ap. Orib.7.16.3

ἐνευδαιμονέω.definition: to be happy in, Th.2.44, D.S.34.3; Lib.Or.14.43

ἐνευδοκιμέω.definition: gain glory in, D.18.198, cf. D.S.34.2.18, J.Ap.1.5, Plu.2.71a; Cod.Just.1.2.25.1. 2. enjoy repute with another, Ael.VH8.12

ἐνευεργετέω.definition: in Pass., well-treated, dub. in PLond. 2.177.26

ἐνευκαιρέω.definition: pass one's time in, Ph.2.522, cf. 1.387

ἐνευλογέομαι.definition: Pass., to be blessed in, Act.Ap.3.25, LXXGe.12.3, Ep.Gal.3.8:—Med., take a blessing to oneself, LXX1 Ki.2.29

ἐνεύχομαι.definition: adjure, implore, Test.Epict.1.13, Herod.6.46; IG5.1208.50 : c. dat., of god invoked, PMag.Par.1.2258; also I adjure you by A. not to . ., PBaden 51

ἐνεχυράζω.definition: fut. D.47.79 (but; c. acc. rei, take in pledge, D.24.197; Aeschin.3.21, cf. LXXDe.24.6, al., D.H.6.29, PPetr.3pp.56,69: abs., Plb.6.37.8 :—Pass., I have my goods seized for debt, Ar.Nu.241:—Med., have security given o…

ἐνεχυρασία.definition: taking property in pledge, security taken, pledge, Pl.Lg.949d, IG 2.1055.7 , PSI4.288 , etc.; D.47.76, 80

ἐνεχύρασμα.definition: pledge, thing pawned, LXXEx.22.26, al., PHamb.10.42

ἐνέχυρον.definition: pledge, security, and to offer a pledge, Hdt.2.136; And.1.39; ibid., X.An.7.6.23; Antipho6.11; Hermipp.29; PHib.1.46 , etc.; make a thing a pledge, put it in pawn, Ar.Pl.451, cf. Ec.755; Pl.Lg.820e; give on security, …

ἐνζεύγνυμι.definition: yoke, A.R.1.686; bind; metaph., involve in, A.Pr.108; . . . . ib.578

ἐνζωγραφέω.definition: paint in or on, Pl.Phlb.40a , Tz.H.12.560

ἔνηβος.definition: in the prime of youth, from fifteen upwards, Sch.Theoc.8.3

ἐνήδομαι.definition: Pass., rejoice in, Mich.in EN532.4, Sch.Il.8.51, Hsch.: abs., Gal.16.566

ἐνήδονος.definition: full of joy, delightful, Sch.E.Hec.828; 'glad eye', Heph.Astr.1

ἐνηής.definition: Ep. Adj. kind, gentle, . . Il.17.204; 23.252; of Athena, Od.8.200; Il.23.648; Hes.Th.651: later in nom. IG14.1648.8; etym. of Corn.ND21: pl., Opp.C.2.89; Id.H.2.644; of stars, propitious, Max.262, al

ἐνημερεύω.definition: spend the day in, D.S.17.70; Id.32.16, cj. in Thphr.Char.8.14

ἐνησυχάζω.definition: = . ., to be quiet in, ChioEp.16.7, Ph.2.140

ἐνήχησις.definition: musical accompaniment of a song, Et.Gud.576.34

ἐνθακέω.definition: sit in or on, S.El.267, cf. OC1293

ἐνθαλασσεύω.definition: Att. live at sea, Ael.NA9.63; to be at sea, Longus2.12; Ph.1.287

ἐνθάλασσος.definition: Att. in the sea, D.S.3.44; by the sea, Ath.Mech.32.3

ἐνθάπτω.definition: bury in a place, CIG2839.10 ,al.:—Pass., aor. 2 Aeschin.1.99, D.S.1.66, IG12.114 , CIG 2824 ; part. ib.2839.11 : fut. 2 ib.2826 , Ph.2.108, Plu.Dio43

ἐνθεάζω.definition: to be inspired, Hdt.1.63, Luc.DDeor.18.1:—Med., Id.Alex.13, Plu.2.623c, etc

ἐνθερίζω.definition: spend summer in a place, Poll.1.62; Dicaearch.1.21

ἐνθερμαίνω.definition: heat, in Pass., is heated by passion, S.Tr.368

ἐνθετταλίζομαι.definition: become a Thessalian, i.e. wear the large Thessalian cloak , Eup.201

ἐνθλίβω.definition: press in, Nic.Al.454, Aret.SA1.9, Gal.UP5.15, S.E.P.3.68:—Pass., Arist.HA599b20, Pr.927a25; Peripl.M.Rubr.62

ἐνθουσιασμός.definition: inspiration, enthusiasm, frenzy, Democr.18, Pl.Ti.71e, Ph.1.535 , S.E.M.9.20 ; Phld.Ir.p.67 W.; produced by certain kinds of music, Arist.Pol.1340a11, 1342a7

ἐνθουσιαστής.definition: person inspired, possessed, Ptol.Tetr.180, Eust.47 fin

ἐνθριόω.definition: wrap in a fig-leaf: muffle up, in pf; metaph., deceive, cozen, Men.Sam.241; cf. Hsch

ἐνθρομβόομαι.definition: become clotted, of blood, Aspasia ap.Aët.16.72; become full of clotted blood, Gal.8.409

ἐνθρονίζω.definition: place on a throne, metaph., LXX4 Ma.2.22:—in lit. sense only Pass., ib.Es.1.2; D.S.33.13

ἐνθρονισμός.definition: enthroning, title of by Pindar, Suid

ἔνθρυπτος.definition: crumbled and put into liquid; title of Apollo at Athens, Hsch

ἐνθρύπτω.definition: poet. crumble into liquid, make sop, Hp.Salubr.7, cf. LXX, Thd.Bel.33; Nic.Th.81; ib.655: —Med., Id.Al.266:—Pass., Lynceus ap.Ath.3.109e

ἐνθυμέομαι.definition: fut. Lys.12.45, later; c. gen., think much or deeply of, Semon.2; Hermipp.41; Antipho5.6; Th.1.42, cf. Pl.Mx.249c, X.Mem.1.1.17; . . Lys.16.20; also Pl.R.595a

ἐνθύμησις.definition: consideration, esteem, E.Fr.246; consideration, reflection, Th.1.132, Ev.Matt.9.4 , Sm.Jb.21.27, Vett. Val.301.8, etc

ἐνθυμίζομαι.definition: later form of D.C.Fr.57.80b; = App.Mith.120.—Act. only in Hsch

ἐνθύμιος.definition: taken to heart, weighing upon; meaning, Ph.2.484; ideas, Iamb.VP5.20; reflect, c. acc. et inf., Alciphr.3.10; I take the hint, Ach. Tat.2.7

ἐνθωρακίζω.definition: arm: pf. part. Pass. mailed, X.An.7.4.16

ἐνιαυσιαῖος.definition: = sq. III, Arist.Cat.5b5; = sq. I, J.AJ3.10.1; Gp.3.2.1

ἐνιαύσιος.definition: annual, Hom.Epigr.15.11; Hdt.4.180, etc.; IG12.593 B5 : neut. pl. as Adv., Hes.Op.449. Regul.Adv. Sch.Arat.462, PLond.1.113.11

ἐνιαυτίζομαι.definition: spend a year, Pl.Com.113: late in Act., Sch.E.Or.1645, Suid

ἐνιαυτοκράτωρ.definition: zodiacal sign presiding over the year according to the Chaldean dodekaeteris, SerapioinCat.Cod. Astr.8.231

ἐνιαυτός.definition: prop. anniversary; = a year, Il.2.295; 8.404; 2.134; Pl.Ti.47a; LXXLe.25.29; during a year, Od.1.288; Indut. ap. Th.4.118; IG12.1.12 ; Lys.32.8; . . at what time in the year, Ar.Fr.569.7; twice a year, Pl.Criti.118e; …

ἐνιαυτοφορέω.definition: bear fruit a year before it ripens, Thphr.HP3.4.1

ἐνίζω.definition: to set in, Ep. aor. 1 Med. he placed; intr., = pf. sit in or on, c.acc., E.Hel.1108 , prob. in A.Ch.801 : c. dat., . . Pl.Smp.196b; Gal.2.691; Id.11.354:—Med., Aret.CA2.8

ἐνιππομαχέω.definition: fight a cavalry action in, D.H.2.13

ἐνισχύω.definition: strengthen, confirm; intr., prevail in or among, Arist.EN1180b4: abs., Id.PA653a31 al.; Thphr.Sens.63, cf. 67; D.S.20.58; . . the opinion prevailed that . ., Id.5.57

ἐνίσχω.definition: = to keep in one's voice, Plu.Cic.35:—Pass., to be held fast, Hdt.4.43; A.R.1.11; v.l. for in X.An.7.4.17; of phlegm, etc., to be impacted, Gal.15.221

ἐνιψηφίζομαι.definition: put to the vote, Maiuri NuovaSilloge 443

ἐνλαξεύω.definition: carve in or on, pf. Pass. AP3.9Arg

ἐνναετία.definition: period of nine years, Sch.Il.1.1; cf

ἐνναίω.definition: dwell in, E.Hel.488; . . S.Ph.472, cf. Lyr.Alex.Adesp.35.22; S.OC788: c. acc. loci, inhabit, Mosch.4.36, A.R.1.1076: in later Prose, Aristid.Or.46.27: 3pl. fut. Med. A.R.4.1751: 3pl. aor. 1 Med. ib.1213, Call.Del.15: …

ἐνναυπηγέομαι.definition: Pass., have ships built in it, of a place, v.l. in Th.1.13

ἐννεάβοιος.definition: worth nine beeves, Il.6.236, Eleg.Alex.Adesp.1.3:—but also glossed by Hsch

ἐννεαγράμματον.definition: word of nine letters , Olymp.Alch.p.71 B

ἐννεαδάκτυλος.definition: with nine fingers, Ptol.Heph. ap. Phot.Bibl.p.147B

ἐννεαέτης.definition: nine years old, IG9.639 , Annales du Service19.223

ἐννεακαιδεκαετηρίς.definition: cycle of nineteen years, D.S.12.36, Placit.2.32.2, Ptol.Tetr.205

ἐννεακαιδεκαπλασίων.definition: gen. nineteen times as large as, Placit.2.25.1, cf. Ach.Tat.Intr.Arat.20

ἐννεάκλινος.definition: with nine dining-couches, Phryn.Com.66, D.S.31.9, Them.Or.18.223a

ἐννεάκρουνος.definition: with nine spouts, name of a well at Athens, in earlier times called Hdt.6.137, Th.2.15, Polyzel.2: metaph. of an orator, copious, Lib.Ep.1493.4

ἐννεάμηνος.definition: of or in nine months, Hdt.6.69, cf. Hp.Septim.8; Gal.Nat.Fac.3.3; BGU977.13

ἐννεάμυκλος.definition: having nine stripes or folds, hence, nine years old, Call.Fr.180, cf. Hsch

ἐννεασύλλαβος.definition: nine-syllabled, Steph.in Rh.321.16, AP13.19 tit.: , Heph.10.2

ἐννεαφάρμακος.definition: consisting of nine ingredients, of remedies, Heraclid.Tar. ap. Gal.14.186, Cels.5.19.10, Androm. ap. Gal.13.310, Orib.Fr.142

ἐννεάχειλος.definition: with nine lips, Nicom.Ar.1.14; Ion. for sq., read by Aristarch. in Il.5.860, and mistranslated as, =

ἐννεάχορδος.definition: of nine strings: Subst. Phillis ap.Ath.14.636b

ἐννέμω.definition: feed cattle in a place, SIG685.82 , D.C.72.3:—Med., of the cattle, Ph.2.118 ; of fish, Opp.H.1.5; also, live amongst, LXX3 Ma.3.25

ἐννεοσσεύω.definition: c.acc., hatch as in a nest, Pl.Alc.1.135e; Them.Or.24.307d:—Pass., to be hatched, Pl.R.573e

ἐννήχομαι.definition: swim or float in . ., Ph.1.385, Plu.2.994b, Antyll. ap.Orib.6.27.5: metaph., Ph.1.693: —later in Act., Gal.UP15.5, prob. in Lib.Decl.32.20: metaph., Gal.2.461

ἐννοέω.definition: Ion. aor. 1 part. Hdt.1.68,86: pf; c. acc., reflect upon, consider, Hdt.1.68, cf. 3.6; Eup.11.6 D.; . . Pl.Tht.161b, cf. S.Ant.61; Id.Ph.1440; E.Med.882, cf. 900; Pl.Criti.121b

ἐννόημα.definition: notion, concept, Arist.Metaph.981a6, Epicur.Ep.1p.5U., LXXSi.21.11, Aristeas189, D.H.Comp.25, Plot.6.6.12, etc.; object of thought, Zeno Stoic.1.19, etc

ἐννοσσοποιέομαι.definition: Med., make oneself a nest on, LXX4 Ma.14.16

ἐννυκτερεύω.definition: pass the night in, Plb.3.22.13; stand for a night, of preparations, Dsc.2.76.9, Philum. ap. Orib.45.29.7, Gal.13.1046

ἐννυχεύω.definition: to sleep in or on, Plu.2.434e; sink, of a star, Babr.124.16

ἑνοειδής.definition: single, simple, Nicom.Harm.12; resembling, having the form of unity, Plot.6.9.5, Jul.Or.4.139b, al., Procl.in Prm.p.540 S., etc.; opp. Dam.Pr.45: Comp., ib.38, Procl.Inst.62: Sup., Id.in R.1.177. Adv. Jul.Or.4.143b, N…

ἐνοικειόω.definition: introduce among; to be related, LXXEs.8.1

ἐνοικίζω.definition: settle in a place, plant, fix in, A.Fr.252; introduce a tenant into premises, BGU 1116.18

ἐνοίκιος.definition: in the house, keeping at home; house-rent, Lys.Fr.27, Is.6.21, D.48.45, AP11.251 , Plu.Sull.1: pl., BCH6.10 , Ps.-Luc.Philopatr.20, POxy.104.15 : metaph., Thphr. ap. Plu.2.135e; rent in general, BGU32.3, PTeb.520

ἐνοικολογέω.definition: receive rent, PFlor.1.7 : c. acc., receive rent for, PLond.5.1708.39

ἐνοικουρέω.definition: keep house, of a garrison, . . D.H.6.3: metaph., Luc.Philops.39

ἐνοινοχοέω.definition: pour in wine, c. acc. cogn., v.l. in Od.3.472; v.l. ant. in Il.4.3

ἐνομματόω.definition: to furnish with eyes, Ph.1.586, al.:—Pass., ib.540, al

ἐνομόργνυμι.definition: wipe on:—Med., impress, Plu.2.1081b; impress the feelings of the vulgar upon it, Id.Cic.32

ἐνοπλίζω.definition: adapt to . ., Lyc.205; Med., arm oneself, Ath.1.16a:—Pass., pf. part. armed, Aq.Ex. 13.18

ἐνοπλισμός.definition: mistranslation of Hebr. hōmeš 'belly' , Aq.2 Ki.2.23,3.27

ἐνοπτρίζω.definition: reflect, Damian.Opt.10:—Pass., to be seen as in a mirror, Porph.Marc.13, Olymp.in Mete.230.17:—Med., see as in a mirror, Ph.1.451, cf. Plu.2.696a; Hierocl.in CA Praef.p.416M

ἐνόπτρισις.definition: representation as in a mirror, reflection, Plot.3.6.17

ἔνοπτρον.definition: mirror, E.Hec.925 , Or.1112, Not.Scav. 1920.328: generally, reflecting surface, Arist.Mete.345b26, cf. 372a33

ἐνορκίζομαι.definition: Med., make one swear, IG12.697.4 ; ib.9.643 , cf. J.AJ8.15.4 :—later in Act., 1 Ep.Thess.5.27; Tab. Defix.Aud.26.15

ἐνορμάω.definition: rush in, Plb.16.28.8 ; = , Hp. ap. Gal.7.597 and Pall.in Hp.2.200D

ἐνορμέω.definition: ride at anchor in a harbour, Plb.16.29.13: metaph., Ph.1.523:—Med., J.AJ15.9.6

ἐνορμίζω.definition: bring a ship to land: hence metaph., Opp.H.3.409:—Med., enter harbour, Str.5.4.6, D.H.1.56, Ph.2.8, etc.: metaph., Id.1.688, al.:—also in Pass., Thgn.1274

ἐνουλίζομαι.definition: Pass., to be curly, of hair, Aristaenet.1.1, Alciphr.Fr. 5.4

ἐνουρέω.definition: aor. 1 Eup.45:—make water in, Hdt.1.138, 2.172; Porph.Abst.3.3; Hermipp.82.1: abs., like piss-a- beds, Ar.Lys.402, cf. Arist.Pr.876a15, Dsc.Eup.2.106, Paul.Aeg.3.45

ἐνουσιόομαι.definition: acquire substance; subsist in, Hierocl.in CA2p.422M

ἐνοφείλω.definition: owe on security, IG14.956B16 : generally, owe, POxy.986:—Pass., to be due upon a security, to one, D.53.10; secured on property, Id.49.45: generally, to be due, owing, PRev.Laws18.17, al. , cf. IG2.1134, PTeb.17.6 , etc

ἐνοφθαλμιάζομαι.definition: Pass., admit of being inoculated, Plu.2.640b tit

ἐνοφθαλμιάω.definition: cast longing eyes upon, v.l. for Poll.2.62

ἐνοφθαλμίζω.definition: inoculate, bud, Thphr.CP5-5.4, cf. Gp.10.77.1:—Pass., Inscr.Délos 366 B20, Procl.in Cra.p.39P

ἐνοχλέω.definition: Aeol. and poet. 2sg. Theoc.29.36; c. dat., give trouble or annoyance to, Lys.24.21; Isoc.4.7; X.An.2.5.13, cf. Amphis15, Epicur.Nat.11.10; D.3.5, etc

ἐνόχλησις.definition: annoyance, Philem.92.3 , PLond.3.971.4 ; Arist.Int.17a37, cf. D.L.7.14,112, Procl.in Alc.p.333 C

ἑνόω.definition: make one, unite, Arist.Pol.1261b10: Archyt. ap. Stob.1.41.2; Herm. ap. eund.1.49.3; Ph.1.609: to bury him, Philostr.Im.2.29; of mixing drugs, Dsc.Eup.1.13, cf. 1.31 :—Pass., Ph.1.471, al., Cleom.2.1, etc.; Arr.Epict.1…

ἐνράπτω.definition: sew up in, Aen.Tact.31.9, Plu.Arat.25:—Med., into his thigh, Hdt.2.146, cf. IG14.1285, 1292:—Pass., to be sewed up in, E.Ba.286; Aen.Tact.31.32; J.AJ3.8.9

ἐνριζόω.definition: implant, Hp.Oss.12; Gal.UP7.15; Nonn.D.42.411: Pass., Gal.UP11.14: so metaph., to be rooted, grounded in, Dam.Pr.258; ib.34; of conditions, become firmly established, Orib.Syn.9.12.1

ἐνσαρόομαι.definition: Pass., to be swept about in . ., . . Lyc.753

ἐνσβέννυμαι.definition: Pass., to be quenched in, Dsc.5.80.2

ἐνσείω.definition: pf. BGU136.11 :—brandish; c. acc. pers., plunge in, drive into, S.Ant.1274; BGU l.c.; Luc.Asin.31; Gal.7.182; Alciphr.3.27; Plu.2.588b; Luc.Merc.Cond.30; Plu.Phoc.23; Macho ap.Ath.13.579f:—Pass., to be jockeyed into a…

ἐνσκέλλω.definition: dry or wither up, . . Nic.Th.694:-Pass., with pf. Act. to be dry, withered, Hp.Morb.1.28; AP12.166 : also of timber, to be dry, seasoned, A.R.3.1251

ἐνσκευάζω.definition: get ready, prepare, Ar.Ach.1096; dress in, Plu.Lyc.15, cf. Luc.Nec.8; . . dressed you up as Hercules, prob.l.in Ar.Ra.523:—Med., dress oneself up, Id.Ach.384, Pl.Cri.53d; Phryn.Com.2 D.; arm oneself, X.Cyr.8.5.11; hav…

ἔνσκευος.definition: with a mask on, v.l. for Poll.4.141

ἐνσκηνοβατέομαι.definition: Pass., to be brought on the stage, Alciphr.2.4.6

ἐνσκήπτω.definition: Ep. hurl, dart in or upon; intr., fall in or on, Hdt.8.39; Arist.Pr.906b24; Plu.Aem.24; Ael.NA14.27; Aret.SD2.2; D.C.53.29: abs., Ruf.Fr.118; of love, Alciphr.1.13

ἐνσκιατροφέομαι.definition: Pass., to live in the shade, to feed on sickly hopes, Plu.2.476e

ἐνσκιρρόω.definition: harden:—Pass., become callous, inveterate, of diseases, X.Eq.4.2, Thd.Is.27.1, Sch.Ar.V.920

ἐνσπαργανόω.definition: wrap as in swathing bands, in Pass., Longin.44.3; Heraclit.All.1

ἐνσπειράομαι.definition: Pass., to be coiled up in, S.E.M.7.410: metaph., to be involved, wrapped up in, Heraclit.All.2

ἐνσπείρω.definition: Ep. sow in, A.R.3.1185:—Pass., Jul.Or.6.194c; Iamb.Myst.3.27

ἐνσπουδάζω.definition: employ oneself actively in, Philostr.VS1.25.2,al.; Lib.Or.11.268

ἐνσταλάζω.definition: = Ar.Ach.1034, Luc.Tox.37: aor. 2 part. Pass. v.l. for in Dsc.1.77

ἐνστίζομαι.definition: Pass., to be embroidered in a web, D.C.63.6

ἐνστομίζω.definition: put into one's mouth, PMag.Par.1.2144, cf. Suid

ἐνστόμιος.definition: in the mouth, Dsc.1.96; Antyll. ap. Orib.45.16.4; Ph.1.373; PMed.Lond.155.2.5

ἐνστόρνυμι.definition: lay, :—Pass., spread over, Antyll. ap. Orib.45.2.5

ἐνστρατοπεδεύω.definition: encamp in, Th.2.20; Plu.Thes.27:— Med., Hdt.9.2, D.C.50.12

ἐνσυγκαταζέω.definition: make to boil together, Mnesith. ap. Orib.4.4.4

ἐνσφηνόομαι.definition: Pass., to be wedged in, fit close, Dsc.5.21, Paul.Aeg.3.77, Procl.ad Hes.Op.425; stoppered with a reed, Dsc.5.31

ἐνσχερώ.definition: Adv. in a row, A.R.1.912, prob. in Antim.16.5

ἐνσχηματίζω.definition: arrange or set a fracture, Gal.18.333

ἐνσχολάζω.definition: spend one's leisure in a place; spend time upon, Id.2.428, cf. Them.Or.2.39b: abs., theorize, in his molestiis Cic.Att.7.11.2

ἐνσωμάτωσις.definition: incarnation, embodiment, Iamb. ap. Stob.1.49.40, cf. Anon.in Tht.57.30, Herm. ap. Stob.1.49.44

ἐνσωρεύω.definition: heap on or in, Sch.Pi.P.7Intr.:— Pass., [Emp.] Sphaer.123

ἐνταράσσω.definition: Att. Ion. , toss about, Aristaenet.2.22:—Med., cause confusion in, Philostr.VA3.20:—Pass., Arist.Phgn.812b8

ἐνταφιάζω.definition: prepare for burial, lay out, LXXGe.50.2, Ev.Matt.26.12, Plu.2.995c, AP11.125: metaph., Plu.Dio44:—Med., Phld.Mort.38

ἐνταφιασμός.definition: laying out for burial, Ev. Marc.14.8, Sch.Ar.Pl.1009, etc

ἐνταφιαστής.definition: undertaker, embalmer, LXXGe.50.2, POxy. 476.8 , PPar.7.6 , Ptol.Tetr.180, AP11.125, etc.; of the Bactrian dogs, Str.11.11.3

ἐντειχίζω.definition: build or fortify in a place; Med., wall in, i.e. blockade, Th.6.90; but also, fortify, Nic.Dam.Fr.66.32 J., Plu.Pomp.28: plpf. D.C.42.38

ἐντεκταίνομαι.definition: build or fix in, v.l. for Hp.Art.47, cf. Apollon. Cit. ad loc

ἐντελετέω.definition: to be inspired, frenzied, Hsch. s.v

ἐντελευτάω.definition: end one's life in . ., Th.2.44, Lib.Or.18.31

ἐντελέχεια.definition: full, complete reality, opp. Arist.de An.412a27; Id.GA734a30; distd. fr. actuality, opp. activity, Id.Metaph.1050a23, Ph.257b8, cf. Ph.1.625 , Plot.4.7.8; later, S.E.M.10.340, cf. Theo Sm.p.37 H.: confused with by Cic…

ἐντελεχής.definition: only as f.l. for e.g. Thphr.CP5.1.10, Ph.2.587; and so Adv. Pl.Lg.905e

ἐντεμένιος.definition: having statues in the SIG1037.4 , Inscr.Prien.123.10

ἐντέμνω.definition: Ion. cut in, engrave upon; cut up a victim, sacrifice, to a hero, Th.5.11, cf. Luc.Scyth.1; Plu.Sol.9:—Med., . . should get it cut up, Ar.Lys.192:—Pass., Dion.Byz.14

ἐντεριώνη.definition: inmost part, pith or heart-wood of plants, Hp.Mul.1.78, Thphr.HP3.17.5, 1.2.6, Porph.Gaur.3.3, Luc.VH2.37

ἐντεροκήλη.definition: intestinal hernia, rupture, Dsc.1.74 , Gal.7.36, Cels.7.18

ἐντεροκηλήτης.definition: one who suffers from rupture, Gloss.:—hence suffering from intestinal hernia, Dsc.1.110.2, Gal.14.789

ἐντεροφύλαξ.definition: name of a surgical instrument, Hermes38.282

ἐντευτλανόομαι.definition: Pass., to be stewed in beet , of eels, Ar.Ach.894 , Aret.CA1.2

ἐντίκτω.definition: bear or produce in, E.Andr.24; drop eggs into the mud, Hdt.2.93: abs., bear children in a place, Th.3.104; Arist.HA552b29; of the cuckoo, ib.563b31. 2. create or cause in, . . E.Hipp.642; Pl.Lg.870a, 843b, 870c, Phdr.…

ἐντιμάω.definition: value in or among, D.41.27; D.C.48.8; highly valued, valuable, Sophr.100 codd. Ath. :—Med., value in giving a dowry, Poll.8.142

ἐντιμόομαι.definition: Pass., to be held in honour, LXX4 Ki.1.13

ἔντιμος.definition: of persons, in honour, honoured, opp. Pl.Euthd.281c, etc.; by another, S.El.239 , Ant.25, etc.; Pl.Ti.21e: c. dat. rei, honoured with, E.Or.1688 ; in office, Pl.R.564d; of men of high rank in Persia, X.Cyr.3.1.8, al.;…

ἐντολή.definition: injunction, order, command, freq. in pl., orders, commands, Pi.Fr.177, Hdt.1.22, 3.147, A.Pr.12, etc.; 1 Ep.Cor.7.19; Decr. ap. D.18.75; Hdt.1.157; royal ordinance, PTeb.6.10 ; of Imperial ordinances, SIG888.51 ; by p…

ἔντοπος.definition: in or of a place, S.Ph.212 , 1171 , OC1457, Pl.Lg.848d, prob. in Nausicr.1; prob. in OGI629.70

ἐντορεύω.definition: carve in relief on . ., Plu.Cic.1:—Pass., Id.2.164a, 399f, Luc.Ind.8

ἐντορνεύω.definition: turn by the lathe, in pf. Pass. HeroAut.16.2

ἔντορνος.definition: turned with the lathe, Pl.Lg.898a; perfectly rounded, Arist.Cael.287b15, cf.IG2.1054f24; IG22.244.101 . Adv. HeroAut.23.3

ἐντρανίζω.definition: look keenly at, Eust.259.8, Sch.Theoc.10.18; Eustr.in EN312.1

ἐντρέφω.definition: poet. = bring up or train in, E.Ion1428; AP9.231 :—Med., Hes.Op.781, cf. Hp.Aër.12 :—Pass., to be raised or bred in, E.Ph.368, cf. Call.Iamb.1.184; Pl.Lg.798a; Plu.2.32e, 38b; Arr.Epict.4.4.48; 1 Ep.Ti.4.6

ἐντρέχεια.definition: skill, aptitude, Corn.ND18, M.Ant.1.8; concrete, an industry, Str.17.1.15

ἔντριχος.definition: hairy, AP14.62, Sm.Ps.67.22; with; Subst., wig. Poll.2.30

ἐντροπόω.definition: fasten the oars with thongs, Hsch.:—Med., Agath.5.22; cf

ἐντρυλλίζω.definition: or whisper in one's ear, Ar.Th.341; term used in quail-baiting, Poll.9.109

ἐντρυφάω.definition: revel in, delight in, c. dat; treat haughtily or contemptuously, E.Cyc.588, Plu.Them.18, Alciphr.1.35; exult over, Jul.ad Ath.279c; LXXHb.1.10: abs., Plu.Alc.23:—Pass., to be made a mock of, Id.Lys.6, Caes.64

ἐντρύφημα.definition: thing to take pleasure in, a delight, LXXEc.2.8 , Ph.1.690

ἐντρύχομαι.definition: Pass. or Med., waste away, D.C.38.46 codd

ἐντυγχάνω.definition: c. dat. rei, = S.Aj.433; cj. Valck. in E.Fr.287; of the crocodile, Hdt.2.70; . . he who fell in their way, Th.4.40; of obstacles, X.An.2.3.10; ib.4.2.10

ἐντυλίσσω.definition: wrap up, Ar.Pl.692, Nu.987 , Diocl.Com.13, Gal.10.541; Ev.Matt.27.59

ἔντυπος.definition: coined, Poll.3.86; receiving impressions, impressible, Plot.4.6.3

ἐντύπωσις.definition: impression, dint, pit, Thphr.Sens.51, Antyll. ap. Orib.45.2.1: metaph., Gal.10.74

ἐντυραννέομαι.definition: Pass., live under a tyranny, Cic.Att.2.14.1

ἐντύχημα.definition: = sq., in pl. prob. for Plu.Phoc.5, cf. Him.Ecl.32.4

ἐνυβρίζω.definition: insult or mock one in a thing; c. dat. pers., insult, Plb.10.26.3, cf. POxy.237 vi 17 ; D.S.34.2

ἐνυγροθηρευτής.definition: one who seeks his prey in the water, fisherman, Pl.Lg.824b

ἐνυπάρχω.definition: exist or be present in; to be immanent or inherent, = Arist.Ph.193a10, cf. 194b24; ib.233b35; the inherence whereof is the cause of existences, Id.Metaph.998a31, cf. 1014a26, Plot.5.3.11, Jul.Or.4.140c, etc

ἐνυπνιάζω.definition: dream, Arist.Insomn.459a21, Somn.Vig.453b19, HA537b13, al.:—in Med. and Pass. c. acc., Hp.VM10, cf. Arist.HA587b10, Ph.1.672, Plu.Cat.Ma.23: so in fut. LXXJl.3.1, Lyd.Ost.33: aor. Med. LXXJd.7.13, ib.Ge.37.5,6,10

ἐνυπνιάστρια.definition: she who dreams, title of book, prob. in IG2.992ii6

ἐνυπνιόμαντις.definition: one who divines by dreams, Hsch. s.v

ἐνύπνιον.definition: thing seen in sleep, in appos; after Hom., = dream, the vision of a dream, Hdt.8.54; A.Pers.518, cf. 226, Pl.R.572b; Pi.O.13.79; Ar.V.25, Pl.Plt.290b; Id.R.443b; Theoc.21.29, Sammelb.685 :—Artem. distinguishes a mere …

ἐνύπνιος.definition: in sleep, in dreams appearing, A.Th.710; AP12.124

ἐνυπόκειμαι.definition: subsist in, Aristombr. ap. Stob.1.52.21, cf. Hierocl.in CA11p.438M

ἐνυποτάσσω.definition: fut. Pass. to be made subject, LXXTo.14.9 cod. Alex

ἐνύφασμα.definition: pattern woven in, D.S.17.70, Antyll. ap. Orib.9.14.7

ἐνωμοτάρχης.definition: leader of an , Th.5.66 codd., X.Lac.11.4, Ascl.Tact.2.2:—also X.An.3.4.21 , Arr.Tact.6.2

ἐνώμοτος.definition: confirmed by oaths, PLond.1.113.1 . Adv. POxy.904.3; Subst., conspirator, Plu.Sert.26

ἐνώπιος.definition: facing, to the front; neut. as Adv., face to face, Theoc.22.152; in person, IG12.1061.10 , PTeb.14.13 : as Prep. c. gen., Aeschin.3.43 codd., PCair.Zen.73.14 , PGrenf.1.38.11 , Ep.Rom.12.17, Ep.Gal.1.20, Hermog.Inv.1.…

ἐνωτίζομαι.definition: give ear, hearken to, LXXGe.4.23; Act.Ap.2.14: c.dat., LXXEx.15.26

ἐξαγκυλόω.definition: fasten by an Poll.5.56 :—Med., take a spear by the Sch.Nic.Th.170

ἐξαγκωνίζω.definition: nudge with the elbow, Ar.Ec.259; bind one's hands behind his back, D.S.34.2, Ph.2.564; D.S.13.27: metaph., Ph.2.128

ἐξαγοράζω.definition: buy from, Plb.3.42.2; buy up, Plu.Crass.2; buy off, Dicaearch.1.22; redeem, D.S.36.2; Ep.Gal.3.13:—Med., Ep.Col.4.5, cf. Ep.Eph.5.16

ἐξαγριαίνω.definition: make savage, Pl.Ly.206b; Ph.1.670; intr. in Act., = Pass., App.Ill.23

ἐξαγριόω.definition: make wild or waste, opp; = foreg., make savage, Hdt.6.123, E.Ph.876:—Pass., to be brutalized, Pl.Lg.870a, cf. Ph.1.584, al

ἐξαγώγιον.definition: duty on exports, Inscr.Prien.3.28 , Decr. ap.J.AJ14.10.6, Just.Edict.13.15

ἐξαγωγός.definition: waste-pipe for letting off water; overflow drain, PPetr.2p.14 , etc

ἐξαγωνίζομαι.definition: fight, struggle hard, E.HF155; D.S.13.73 codd

ἑξαγωνίζω.definition: to be in sextile aspect, Ptol.Tetr.115

ἑξαδακτυλία.definition: possession of six fingers, Phlp.in GA194.4

ἑξαδακτυλιαῖος.definition: six inches long, Heliod. ap. Orib.49.4.41

ἑξαδάκτυλος.definition: = foreg., six inches long; having six fingers, Gal.19.454, Eustr.in EN376.1, Tz.H.7.902

ἐξαδιαφορέω.definition: to be utterly indifferent to, Ph.1.214, 2.279

ἐξαδυνατέω.definition: to be quite unable or incapable, c.inf., Arist.Pol.1282b4, Plu.Alc.23; Arist.GA785a10: abs., Id.HA575a21, Plb.1.58.5; Plu.Mar.33; generation becomes impossible, Thphr.CP1.16.3

ἐξαερόω.definition: Ion. make into air, volatilize, Arist.Pr.938b34, Luc.Peregr.30:—Pass., evaporate, Hp.Nat.Puer.25, Arist.Pr.933a36; to be dissipated in perspiration, Aret.SD2.1

ἑξαετία.definition: term of six years, Ph.2.371, J.AJ16.1.1, POxy.101.17 , etc

ἐξαθέλγω.definition: draw or drain off, in Pass., Hp.Oss.19, Hsch

ἐξαθροίζομαι.definition: Med., seek out and collect, E.Ph.1169

ἐξαιγειρόομαι.definition: Pass., of the white poplar , degenerate into a black poplar , Thphr.CP2.16.2

ἐξαιθραπεύω.definition: to be a satrap, SIG167.2 ; cf

ἐξαιθριάζω.definition: expose to sun and air, Hp.Int.35, Dsc.5.16, Apollon. ap.Gal.12.478:—Pass., Com.Adesp. in PLond.ined.2294

ἐξαιματόω.definition: change into blood, Gal.8.359:—Pass., Arist.Somn.Vig.456b4, Ph.2.244

ἐξαιμάτωσις.definition: conversion into blood, of food, ibid., Alex.Aphr.Pr.2.63, Gal.11.139

ἔξαιμος.definition: bloodless, drained of blood, Hp.VC16, Epid.5.6, D.S.3.35, etc

ἐξαιρέσιμος.definition: that can be taken out, days taken out of the calendar, Arist.Oec.1351b15, cf. Cic.Verr.2.2.52.129

ἐξαίσιος.definition: also X.HG4.3.8:—beyond what is; outstepping right, lawless, having done some lawless act, Od.4.690; . . fearing some lawless man, 17.577; . . Il.15.598; B.14.58

ἐξαΐσσω.definition: contr. Att. rush forth, start out, Il.12.145; Ar.Pl.733; Id.Ra.567; start, Arist.Pr.957a32; Phld.Mus.p.12 K., cf. Max. Tyr.37.5; the violence of these passions, Plu.2.83e:—Pass., Il.3.368

ἐξαισχύνομαι.definition: to be ashamed, c. inf., Procl.in Prm.p.648S

ἐξαιτέω.definition: demand or ask for from another, c. dupl; Med., ask for oneself, demand, Act., Hdt.1.159,9.87, S.El.656, etc.; Lys.20.31; Ev.Luc.22.31; for whose aid I prayed, PMag.Par.1.434, cf. 1290

ἐξαιτραπεύω.definition: = to be a satrap, prob. in SIG134.3

ἐξαιφνίδιος.definition: also Pl.Cra.414a, Gal.6.185:—sudden, Pl. l.c.; Gal. l.c.; Hierocl.p.60A

ἐξαιωρέομαι.definition: Pass., to be suspended from a thing, Hp.Art.70

ἐξακανθόομαι.definition: Pass., become prickly, prob. in Thphr.HP6.4.2

ἐξακεστήριος.definition: remedying evil, Lex Solonis; expiatory, Id.5.54

ἐξακμάζω.definition: to be gone by, of an opportunity, Sch.S.Aj.594

ἐξακολουθέω.definition: follow, of persons; of things, follow, result from, c. dat., Epicur.Fr.181; attend, c. dat., Plb.4.5.6, 5.78.4; D.H.Comp.24; esp. of penalties, UPZ112v10 , PTeb.5.132 ; also of obligations, fall on one, CPR5.15, etc

ἐξακοντισμός.definition: = foreg., Gal.4.523, Antyll. ap. Orib.7.10.2; shooting of a shooting star, Arist.Mu.395b5

ἑξακοσίαρχος.definition: captain of six hundred men, Polyaen.Prooem.2

ἐξάκουστος.definition: heard, audible, Ph.Bel.93.51; famous, Sch.D.P.13, Hsch

ἐξακριβόω.definition: make exact, precise, or accurate; intr., speak accurately, Arist.EN1096b30; Plb.2.56.4, cf. Porph.Abst.1.39

ἐξακρίβωσις.definition: strict observance; exact statement, Eustr.in EN108.6

ἐξάκτωρ.definition: = Lat.exactor, BGU21 ii 17, Tz.H.5.607:—hence his office, PLond.2.378.8, PGen.56.32

ἐξάλειπτρον.definition: unguent-box, Ar.Ach.1063, Antiph.208, LXXJb.41.22, IG2.751Biid4,11.161B125, , etc

ἐξαλείφω.definition: pf. Pass. : subj.aor.2; wipe out, obliterate, E.Hel.262: metaph., wipe out of one's mind, Pl.Tht.187b; D.37.34; Men.Pk.310 ; cancel, And.1.76; Lys.1.48; Arist.Ath.40.3; IG12.91.10; esp. at Athens, strike his name off …

ἐξαλέομαι.definition: beware of, avoid, escape, Il.18.586; mostly in Ep. aor. 1 inf., Hes.Op.105, cf. 758,802, Orac. ap.Ar.Eq.1080: abs., A.R.2.319, cf. 3.466: pres. Q.S.2.385.—Ep. word, cf. sq

ἐξαλεύομαι.definition: = foreg., . . . . S.Aj.656 codd., but is prob. l

ἐξάλλαγμα.definition: recreation, amusement, in pl., Anaxandr.20, Parth.24.1

ἐξαλλοιόω.definition: change, alter, LXX3 Ma.3.21:—Pass., change utterly, Thphr.CP2.15.2, cf. Ph.1.674

ἐξαλλοίωσις.definition: metabolism, of food, prob. for Gal.15.250

ἐξαλλοτριόω.definition: export, Str.5.1.9; divert, alienate, BSA17.229 , cf. PGiss.2.24

ἐξαλύσκω.definition: aor. flee from, c. acc., E.El.219, Hipp.673 : abs., escape, A.Eu.111, E.Hec.1194: c. gen., Opp.H.3.104; cf

ἐξαμαρτάνω.definition: Pass., to be mismanaged, to be a failure, Pl.Prt.357d; X.Eq.4.2; Arist.Pol.1289b9

ἐξαμαυρόω.definition: obscure utterly, E.Fr.781.64 :—Pass., of a plant, lose its natural character, Thphr.CP2.16.4: metaph., Ph.2.438; Plu.2.469a; Longin.17.2, dub.l. in Hp.Alim.6

ἐξαμάω.definition: mow or reap out, finish mowing or reaping, A.Pers.822, cf.Ag.1655 , E.Ba.1315; . . sowing and reaping, S.Tr.33; Plu.Demetr.4:—Pass., having all the race cut off root and branch, S.Aj.1178, cf. Paus.8.7.7.—Poet. and la…

ἐξαμβλόω.definition: make abortive: metaph., you have made a notion miscarry, Ar.Nu.137; to which Strepsiades retorts, your abortive thought, ib.139, cf. Pl.Tht.150e; Ph.1.219:—Pass., Thphr.CP4.5.3; Plu.2.2e

ἐξαμελέω.definition: to be utterly careless of, Hdt.1.97: abs., show no care, be negligent, Arist.Pol.1269b22:—Pass.impers., no care is taken . ., Id.EN1180a27; Plu.Cam.18; being uncared for, Arist.EN1180a30; Thphr.HP3.2.2

ἐξαμηχανέω.definition: get out of a difficulty, E.Heracl.495

ἐξαμιλλάομαι.definition: aor. 1 part. and; drive out of, E.Or.431; drive out of his wits, ib.38

ἐξαμυγδαλίζω.definition: make like an almond, Aq.Ex.25.32:—also ib.35

ἐξαμύνομαι.definition: Med., ward off from oneself, drive away, A.Pr.483; E.Supp.208; Id.Or.269:—Act. is dub. l. in Them.Or.23.284b

ἐξαμυστίζω.definition: drink off at a draught, Pl.Com.189

ἐξαμφοτερίζω.definition: make ambiguous, has led the argument into a contradiction , Pl.Euthd.300d; Hsch., cf. EM347.7

ἐξαναγεννάομαι.definition: Pass., to be born again, Jul.Ep.61c

ἐξαναγκάζω.definition: fut. S.Ichn.212:—force or compel; force out, Hp.Haem.2

ἐξανάγω.definition: bring out of or up from, E.Heracl.218:—Pass., put out to sea, set sail, of persons, Hdt.6.98, al., S.Ph.571, Th.2.25, etc.; of ships, Hdt.7.194: metaph., Ph.1.517

ἐξαναιρέω.definition: take out of, h.Cer.254, cf. A.R.3.867:—Med., E.Ion269

ἐξαναισθητέω.definition: to be utterly without feeling, Porph.Abst.1.39 codd

ἐξανακρούομαι.definition: Med., retreat from a place by backing water, . . Hdt.6.115

ἐξαναλαμβάνω.definition: cited in error from Th. by AB93

ἐξαναλίσκω.definition: pf. Pass. Hp.Nat.Puer.30, but; exhaust, Thphr.Vent.15, etc.; Plu.Cat.Mi.20:—Pass., to be used up, exhausted, Arist.GA750a34; Hp.Nat.Puer. l. c.; Sor.1.31; Babr.95.44

ἐξαναπληρόω.definition: supply, replace, D.51.6:— Pass., be renewed, of the bark of trees, Thphr.HP3.17.1

ἐξανάπτω.definition: hang from or by, E.IT1351, cf; kindle, AP5 Prooem. ; Plu.2.752a

ἐξανασπάω.definition: tear away from, Hdt.5.85; E.Ph.1132: tear up from, Id.Ba.1110

ἐξαναστρέφω.definition: turn upside down, S.Fr.727: c. gen. loci, hurl headlong from . ., . . A.Pers.812

ἐξαναφαίνω.definition: bring up and show, Orph.A.1357 , Man.2.153

ἐξανδραποδίζω.definition: reduce to utter slavery, Hdt.6.94, cf. X.HG2.1.15:—mostly in Med. Hdt.1.66, cf. And.4.22, X.HG2.2.16, etc.; confiscate the substance of the deceased, Plb.32.5.11.—The Att. fut. Ion. which is mostly trans. , takes a pa…

ἐξανέχω.definition: hold up from: mostly intr., jut out from; Med. , bear up against, endure, suffer, with part., S.OC1174, cf. Ph.1355, E.Alc.952; Ar.Pax702; E.Med.74, cf. Andr.201; . . that these things should be decreed, Id.Heracl.967

ἐξανθέω.definition: put out flowers, X.Cyn.5.5; metaph., burst forth from the surface, like an efflorescence, E.IT300; bursting into flower, breaking out, A.Pers.821; Arist.Metaph.1010a10; Plu.Thes.6

ἐξάνθημα.definition: efflorescence, eruption, pustule, Hp.Aph.6.9, Epid.1.9, cf. Arist.HA518a12, Ph.2.225: metaph., Plu.2.528d

ἐξάνθησις.definition: = foreg., Hp.Aph.3.20, Ph.2.101; fading, Thphr.CP6.15.2 codd

ἐξάνθρωπος.definition: unsociable, of epileptics, Aret.SD1.4; it is an inhuman calamity, Id.SA1.6

ἐξανιστάνω.definition: = sq., drive out of one's senses, Dsc.4.73

ἐξανίστημι.definition: causal in pres., impf., fut., and aor.1; raise up, S.El.940; make one rise from his seat, Pl.Prt.310a; bid one rise from suppliant posture, . . E.Andr.263, cf. 267; order the men in ambush to rise, X.HG4.8.37

ἐξανοίγω.definition: lay open, Ar.Ach.391; D.S.1.33:—Pass., Str.16.1.10, Ath.Mech.36.9: pf. inf. to be exposed, of high ground, Ath.Med. ap. Orib.9.12.1

ἐξαντλέω.definition: drain or draw off, Pl.Lg.736b, PTeb.123.6 (i; metaph., endure to the end, see out, E.Cyc.10; ib.110; Id.Fr.454; Men.74; E.Supp.838
